title: Content engine for X and TikTok posts
items: New content_engine.py turns this week's ratings, ballot, slate, upset calls, Game of the Week and scorecards into draft posts. Every number comes with its source file and a hash, and each draft expires before it can go out stale.

When the data is stale or there is nothing new, it reports an empty queue instead of finding something to post. Scorecard posts always show the expected rate and the market comparison next to the hit rate.
It can also export a Matchday Studio edition, so a week's graphics load with real teams and logos in one click. Nothing is published automatically.
